oneLiner: A web dashboard that instantly re‑orients product managers when they switch projects, surfacing the latest decisions, current blockers, and pending dependencies.
problem: Product managers juggling multiple projects lose context when they switch focus, resulting in wasted time, missed decisions, and duplicated effort.
targetUser: Product managers who oversee several active projects or cross‑functional initiatives.
coreFlow: Select a project from the project list
View the project snapshot showing last decision, blockers, and pending dependencies
Drill into each section for detailed context and add notes
Update status or assign owners to unblock items

screens.name: Login / SSO
screens.purpose: Authenticate the user and establish a secure session.

screens.name: Project Selector
screens.purpose: Allow the PM to quickly switch between their active projects.

screens.name: Overview Dashboard
screens.purpose: Present a concise snapshot of the most recent decision, current blockers, and who is waiting on what.

screens.name: Decision Detail
screens.purpose: Show full context of the last decision, rationale, and related documentation, with ability to add comments.

screens.name: Blockers & Dependencies
screens.purpose: List active blockers, responsible owners, and pending hand‑offs, enabling quick assignment or escalation.

outOfScope: Full project planning or Gantt charts
Integration with every PM software (only core integrations planned)
